name: ❤ THE LAST HEART ❤
description:
Welcome to The Last Heart! A Dutch/Belgian lifesteal survival server built around short seasons.

HOW IT WORKS

- Lifesteal: kill a player and you gain a heart, die and you lose one. Lose them all and you're out.

- Abilities: unlock and upgrade unique abilities, so no two fights play out the same.

- Seasons: each season starts fresh. The world border starts small and grows daily, pushing everyone closer together.

- Season finale: every season ends with a big final event.

- Fair start: a grace period at the start of every season.

- Combat log protection: logging out in a fight counts as dying.

- 1v1 arenas for friendly duels without risking hearts.

- Revive Tokens can bring eliminated players back.

PLAY ON

- Java 1.21.x and Bedrock (crossplay via Geyser)

- Friendly Dutch/Belgian community

- Fair play: no pay-to-win

JOIN

Java: 152.228.198.167:22157

Bedrock: 152.228.198.167, port 22157

Discord: https://discord.gg/dUeCnpjx6H

Season 1 starts on 26 October at 20:00 (Belgian time). Until then the server is whitelisted. Join the Discord to stay updated!
